result_text:
Staff logins are now limited to the Calendar and Clients; everything else is owner-only. `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass. I couldn't run the app or the integration tests here, so I haven't exercised it as a real staff login.

- **Server-side check:** I added `requireOwner()` in `src/lib/session.ts`. It redirects any session whose role isn't `owner` to `/admin`.
- **Pages:** Services, Staff, Reports, Analytics, Notifications and Audit now use that check. A staff member who opens one of those URLs is sent to the calendar and sees none of the page.
- **Actions:** `saveService`, `toggleService`, `saveStaff`, `toggleStaff` and `toggleStaffService` in `src/app/admin/actions.ts` use the same check. A replayed form submission from a staff login is refused before it touches the database.
- **Booking status:** `updateBookingStatus` still only needs a login, so staff can mark bookings completed, no-show or cancelled.
- **Navigation:** The admin layout shows only Calendar and Clients to staff. The owner sees all the links as before.

The Clients page still shows each client's "Spent" total to staff, since you listed Clients as allowed. If you'd rather staff not see revenue there, say so and I'll hide that column.
